semantics.note: The causal claim and the 'in some cases' scope are preserved. 'Degrading' is a fair rendering of 'into slop'.

contract.note: Reading 'slop' as worse software quality is ordinary. Requiring at least one company case that links AI pressure to the decline fits the 'some cases' scope.

evidence.note: Telemetry links higher AI adoption with more bugs and incidents. It shows association only and does not identify management pressure as the cause.
Amazon's own statement disputing claims that AI caused its outages. It covers one candidate case and does not rule out cases at other companies.

reviews.rationale: The packet shows AI adoption associated with lower quality across many organizations, but no documented company case where pressure to use AI caused the decline. Amazon disputes one candidate example. Zillow's records were not obtained. The evidence does not settle the claim either way.
